notes.pluralKeys: Preserve plural suffixes and supply a translation for each supplied plural form.
notes.productNames: Backchannel, Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, LiteLLM, Parakeet, Whisper, and model identifiers are product names or code identifiers.
notes.structuredTokens: Preserve URLs, file extensions, CSS-like identifiers, [PERSON_1]-style tokens, and literal keys such as {lens_sections}.
notes.excludedContent: Do not translate transcripts, user content, imported documents, AI output, prompts, logs, API payloads, WebSocket payloads, or untranslated backend messages.

context.navigation.language: Accessible label for the header language selector.
context.sessions.state.live: Short session-state label meaning a call is currently active.
context.preCall.sections.directives: Standing instructions that guide analysis during a call.
context.activeCall.youAsked: Label over a question the operator submitted during the call.
context.activeCall.endWithoutBriefing: End-call option that saves the transcript but skips the generated briefing.
context.insights.types.questions: Plural filter-chip label for insight rows of type question.
context.briefing.whyMatters: Disclosure control that reveals an item's rationale.
context.briefing.arbiterNotes: Heading preceding reconciliation notes from the briefing arbiter.
context.overview.sections.openLoops: Meeting questions that remain unanswered or require follow-up.
context.overview.unattributed: Speaker label for transcript text with no known speaker.
context.postProcessing.steps.callBriefing: Post-call pipeline step that generates the meeting briefing.
context.postCall.shielded_other: Count of personal-data values protected by the PII Shield in this session.
context.admin.lens.helper: Explains how analyst-lens prompt sections are inserted into an agent prompt.
context.admin.agent.runningAt: Explains an effective per-model analysis interval set by the local fit test.
context.pii.coverage.refinement: Coverage status for the transcript-refinement stage.
context.pii.tokensOnly: Status meaning a logged model prompt contains only privacy tokens.
context.modelOptions.cloudOff: Reason a cloud model cannot be selected while a privacy switch is on.
context.diarization.matchThreshold: Similarity threshold used when assigning voices to speakers.
context.knowledge.recordCount_other: Number of structured records in one knowledge source.
context.offerings.headers.product: Product or service column in the offerings catalog.
context.tokenUsage.headers.cached: Input tokens served from a provider prompt cache.
context.tokenUsage.headers.audioTokens: Token counts the provider classified as audio input or output.
